messages.author: d00f6178fa8e05fe
messages.subject: number of categories? - categorical distribution
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to recode a model from WinBUGS, but I'm stuck. There are probably more problems not just this one. Thanks for any suggestions.


Latest error is this one: 

"Error : Error in function stan::prob::categorical_log(i): Number of categories is 0, but must be between (1, 500)
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done"

WinBUGS model:

model{
  # Observed Data
  for (i in 1:m){
     k[i] ~ dbin(theta,n)
  }   
  # Priors on Rate Theta and Number n(int)
  theta ~ dbeta(1,1)
  n ~ dcat(p[])
  for (i in 1:nmax){
    p[i] <- 1/nmax
  }
}   

Rstan code:

# clears workspace: 
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE)) 

library(rstan)

model ="
# Inferring Return Rate and Number of Surveys from Observed Returns
data{ 
  int<lower=0> nmax; 
  int<lower=0> m;
  int<lower=0> k[m]; 
}
parameters{
  real<lower=0,upper=1> theta;
} 
transformed parameters{
  simplex[500] p;
  for (i in 1:500)
    p[i] <- 1.0/500;
}
model{
  int n;
  theta ~ beta(1,1);
  n ~ categorical(p);
  for (i in 1:m)
    k[i] ~ binomial(n,theta);
}
"
#myinits="
#list(theta = 0.5, n = nmax/2) 
#"

nmax = 500
k    = c(16,18,22,25,27)
m    = length(k)
#p    = rep(0.002,500)


data = list(k = k, m = m, nmax= nmax) # to be passed on to Stan

# The following command calls Stan with specific options.
samples = stan(model_code = model, data = data, init="random",
               iter = 1000, chains = 1, verbose=T)



Martin Smira

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] number of categories? - categorical distribution
parts:
In the BUGS model, n is a discrete parameter.  So n should be declared as a parameter in Stan instead of a temporary variable.  But Stan does not support discrete parameters yet.  You can integrate n out if it is not of interest.

--
Jiqiang
